summary: Focused verification of the World 2 exit bug fix (TransitionSpacer blocked-until-scroll-above guard). All primary scenarios pass on desktop (1440x900) and mobile (390x844).

test_results.first_visit_auto_entry: PASS — boot → login → scroll to bottom opens World 2 (world2 count=1).
test_results.taskbar_exit_stays_closed: PASS — [data-testid=world2-exit] closes World 2; still closed after 5s and after small scroll wiggles near bottom. Contact section renders (email/github/linkedin testids visible).
test_results.start_menu_exit_stays_closed: PASS — [data-testid=world2-start-button] → [data-testid=world2-back-to-portfolio] closes World 2; still closed after 5s + wiggles. Contact visible.
test_results.reentry_after_scroll_up_then_down: PASS — after exit, scrollTo(0) then scrollTo(bottom) re-opens World 2 (count=1) within ~5s.
test_results.mobile_390_regression: PASS — no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth=clientWidth=390); Contact testids present; taskbar exit works on mobile viewport.

critical_code_review_comments: Fix implementation in Site.tsx + TransitionSpacer.tsx is clean and minimal: exitedRef passed as blockedInitially; internal blocked ref re-arms only when rect.top > window.innerHeight (fully scrolled above doorway). Behavior matches spec.

Minor: blockedInitially only reads on mount because TransitionSpacer is not remounted between exits within a session; that is acceptable given it IS remounted on each exit (world2 toggles) — the ref captures the current exitedRef.current at mount time, which is exactly what's needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix verified end-to-end via Playwright on preview URL. Both exit paths (taskbar + start menu) keep World 2 closed and preserve valid re-entry after scrolling back above the doorway. No regressions on Contact section at desktop or 390px mobile.
